original_test_intent: Configure the intended BMC with an approved static IPv4 address, netmask and default gateway and prove the same BMC is reachable with exactly those effective settings.
original_method: Bind BMC/MAC/channel, validate address ownership and routing, preserve baseline, apply static mode and all three values once, rediscover/authenticate the same device and verify route/link/event health.
manual_activity: The network owner supplies and approves the address plan, channel and rollback; an operator maintains console/OOB access during the management-address transition.
required_inputs: Approved static IP, netmask, gateway, VLAN and address reservation
safety_requirements: Require owner approval and conflict check
Stop on conflict, mismatch or loss of management
No repeated overwrite or blind reset
agent_execution_scope: Validate supplied network plan and BMC identity
Rediscover and authenticate the same BMC
Compare effective IP/netmask/gateway, route, link and events without recovery autonomy or verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm routing, conflict result and rollback

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only a partial post-check; it assumes eth0/current IP, skips TLS verification and cannot perform or prove the required static configuration.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Apply the documented channel-specific static mode/IP/netmask/gateway once, then authenticate the same MAC-bound BMC on the new route.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Static mode, three IP parameters, IPMI/Web UI alternatives, scripts and 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds address ownership/conflict, identity-safe reconnect and explicit rollback.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only Redfish output cannot establish that requested values were safely applied.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong value can strand the BMC or collide with another management endpoint.

project_override_considerations: Any supported API may replace the UI/IPMI transport only if it atomically preserves the same approved values, channel identity, reconnect proof and rollback path.
expected_evidence: Configured and effective network values, route/link and authenticated reachability

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source fields consistently describe static configuration; placeholders are required project inputs rather than contradictory intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Network values, channel, conflict check and rollback can be supplied and validated, enabling conditional execution.

review_improvement: Turns a read-only endpoint assumption into the required approved static-network mutation with address safety and same-device recovery proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Static network success is both configuration equality and continued authenticated reachability of the same BMC. Because wrong values may sever management or collide, user-supplied values and OOB recovery are mandatory.
